$comment: Launches v1 (spec pass S2 draft, 2026-11-07; docs/design/spec-s2-armies.md section 9). DRAFT: new file for data/rules. Integers only: mm, mm/s, mm/s2, cd (centi-degrees), cd/s, ticks at 20 per second, permille, health points. Settled from the brief (2026-10-09, 2026-10-11): ballistic bodies with reduced gravity; distance and damage tuned separately; landing in deep water, off a cliff or into fire kills; a shallow fringe of about 2 m along deep water only stuns; landings knock neighbours down but never launch or kill them; direction from the source's heading with a fixed seeded spread (seed = source event id, soldier id); launched and stunned soldiers stay in their regiment's outline. Launched bodies aren't load. Flight = 2 * vertical / gravity. Landing outcomes by surface; 'swept' hands the soldier to S1's swept state; 'snapToStandable' moves him to the nearest cell where his class can stand. Cliff thresholds come from hazards.json (lethalDropMm, fallHurtMm), measured from the ground he was launched from. Numbers are proposals.
